text:
Leah (CEO): Opening this thread to lock down the follow-ups from today's all-hands Q&A on wins/losses. Please post one signal or one next action. Keep it short.

Ibrahim (Sales): Field signal: we keep winning retailers and low-latency ad stacks. Primary reasons: predictable p95, clear cost math, easy Dedicated staging. Losing HealthTech/Gov on BYOK + deep audit retention.

Cassie (Product): From product side we need 3 tangible deliverables asap: 1) BYOK scoping doc 2) 1-page "security + SLA" PDF for procurement 3) migration playbook template. Which should be first?

Ibrahim (Sales): BYOK scoping highest priority for closing enterprise deals. Migration playbook second.

Ravi (Engineering): Note: BYOK work splits into cloud-KMS (customer-managed) vs HSM-backed key wrapping. HSM increases complexity. Also audit logs: longer retention and immutable write-path add storage and infra work. Need a decision on tiering: 30/90/365 or enterprise-only.

Marta (Customer Success): Customers ask for an "audit readiness" checklist (what to hand legal) + two anonymized SOC2 artifacts. CS can collect examples but needs Product to author the one-pager.

Theo (Solutions): Quick win to include in the sales kit: a short config snippet and expected cost delta. Example we share: 

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 16
  p95_target_ms: 300
  batching: true
prefix_cache: enabled
expected_cost_delta: "~25-35% token cost reduction (seq <1024)"
```

Ibrahim (Sales): Please add a 1-line "why we won" for reps: Ibrahim will post 3 options by EOD.

Cassie (Product): Owners: Cassie -> migration playbook + sales kit; Ravi -> BYOK & retention scoping; Marta -> SOC2 artifacts & procurement one-pager. Target: rough estimates in 7 business days.

comms-bot: Created ticket: PROD-6789 "BYOK + audit-retention + sales artifacts" assigned to Ravi. Link: https://redwood.internal/ticket/PROD-6789

Ravi (Engineering): Taking PROD-6789. Quick ask for Security: post required KMS/HSM acceptance criteria (FIPS level, rotation policy, audit schema). That will determine effort.

Marta (Customer Success): I'll upload redacted SOC2 samples to the ticket. Also request Product include a sample procurement-friendly clause about log retention windows.

Theo (Solutions): Also flagging a migration checklist snippet for docs: pre-checks, staging mirror, perf tuning, weighted rollout, post-run reporting. Sales finds the example rollout numbers helpful.

Leah (CEO): Good. Please post any procurement redlines or competitor objections here. We'll review tickets in the roadmap sync next week. If anyone needs a follow-up meeting tag me. :sparkles:
